LaunchCode Academy — Full-Stack Web Development
ILLUSTRATIVE SYLLABUS · fictional academy · no enrollment or credential

12 weeks full-time / 24 weeks part-time.
Sample tuition: $14,900. No real payment is accepted.

Weeks 1–3: Semantic HTML, responsive CSS, JavaScript and Git foundations.
Projects: accessible profile, interactive data explorer.
Weeks 4–6: React components, state, forms and testing.
Projects: task planner and client-side API interface.
Weeks 7–9: Node.js APIs, PostgreSQL, authentication concepts and security basics.
Project: database-backed catalog.
Weeks 10–12: AWS deployment concepts, accessibility checks and team capstone.
Portfolio: five practice projects plus a capstone.

Part-time covers the same example topics over twice the calendar duration.
Career practice: explaining trade-offs, presenting work, résumé review and mock
interviews. No employment, placement, licensing or accreditation is guaranteed.
